name: The Dingle Way
description_md:
The Dingle Way is a waymarked hiking route in IE that spans 181.3 km. This trail follows a circular shape and is signposted as DW.

The route is part of the national waymarked hiking network and requires about 54 hours of walking time. It involves 3144 m of ascent and 3147 m of descent. The difficulty is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent. The path passes within 100 m of Dingle, 800 m of Riasc Monastic Settlement, and 1400 m of Gallarus Oratory.
